```{python}
#| label: setup
from importlib import import_module
from pathlib import Path
from tomllib import loads

from hpikit.cli import format_epilog

project = loads(Path("pyproject.toml").read_text())["project"]
project_name = project["name"]

export_parser = import_module(f'{project_name}.export').make_parser()
```

```{python}
#| label: export-program
#| output: asis
print(export_parser.description)
```

# Setting up

1. install with PIP
   - `pip3 install --user git+https://github.com/karlicoss/rescuexport`

   - for export functionality: append `[export]`
   - for optional extras for logging and faster json processing: append `[optional]`
   - or any combination of the above, e.g. `[export,optional]`

   - alternatively, clone the repository and run `pip3 install --editable .`.


# Contributing

If you want to contribute/develop this project, check out [github actions](.github/workflows/main.yml) to see how the project is run/tested.

Generally you should be able to run various checks via `tox`, e.g.

`uv tool run --with tox-uv tox`

## Updating README

This README is generated from a 'literate' Quarto [README.qmd](README.qmd) via the following command:

`tox -e quarto`
